title: gateway_centric accepted from any authenticated neighbor's DIO config option — mode flapping
description: dodag.c:368-371: any joined peer's DODAG Configuration option flips d->gateway_centric which drives announce scheduling (announce.c:738-753); no validation against root authoritative config; single malicious joined node toggles neighbors' announce mode per-DIO. Accept config only from adopted root DIO (compare dodag_id/root key); persist last-known-good.
